name: ownCloud Infinite Scale
description: ownCloud Infinite Scale (oCIS) is the modern, cloud-native rewrite of ownCloud built by ownCloud GmbH in Nuremberg. Written in Go with a microservices architecture, it provides enterprise-grade file sync, sharing, and collaboration with horizontal scalability and full data sovereignty.

owner.name: ownCloud GmbH
owner.description: German company developing open-source file sync and collaboration software since 2010.
